physics_goals.quote: The sensitivity of dark matter direct detection will be improved by nearly two orders of magnitude compared to the current best limits, approaching the so-called "neutrino floor" for a dark matter mass above 10 GeV/$c^2$
physics_goals.value: Direct detection of WIMPs down to the neutrino floor and a search for neutrinoless double beta decay of 136Xe

summary.plain: PandaX-xT is a proposed multi-ten-tonne liquid xenon observatory at the Jinping underground laboratory in China, an upgrade of PandaX-4T. It would search for dark matter and for neutrinoless double beta decay, and aims to reach the point where neutrinos become the main background.
summary.technical: Proposed multi-phase upgrade of PandaX-4T to a 43-tonne active liquid xenon target (natural xenon first, isotopic separation later), at CJPL; sensitivity of nearly two orders of magnitude beyond current limits for WIMPs above 10 GeV/c^2 and a [10 - 41] meV/c^2 effective Majorana mass sensitivity from 136Xe; 200 t y exposure goal for WIMPs. No construction start or schedule date is given in the proposal paper.
